info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v4-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETAs API provides accurate estimated time of arrivals (ETAs) for food deliveries. This endpoint allows users to query the expected delivery times of their orders based on real-time data. Typical consumers include restaurant partners and delivery personnel who rely on precise timing to enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. By utilizing this API, businesses can improve their logistics, optimize delivery routes, and enhance the overall customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated time of arrival for deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for their deliveries. By providing the necessary query parameters, users can track when to expect their deliveries, enhancing their planning and communication.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for deliveries. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify the delivery details and location.

200.description: Successful response with estimated delivery time.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to delivery ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival). The expected input is a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the delivery.

resultId.description: ID of the result associated with the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasResponse_2.description: Schema representing the response for the ETA of deliveries operation.

createdBy.description: User who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.
